tools.name: get_airport_crowd_reports
tools.description: Recent traveller-submitted wait time reports for an airport. Small sample, but observed rather than predicted.

iata.description: 3-letter IATA code. Defaults to the airport on the current page.

tools.name: get_airport_security_wait
tools.description: Current security checkpoint wait times for an airport, by terminal and checkpoint where available.

iata.description: 3-letter IATA code. Defaults to the airport on the current page.

tools.name: get_faa_delays
tools.description: Current FAA ground stops, ground delay programmes, and weather impacts across US airports.

tools.name: submit_airport_wait_report
tools.description: Report a wait time you have just observed at an airport queue. Only call this when the traveller has given you a real observed figure; it feeds the public crowd data other travellers see.

iata.description: 3-letter IATA code. Defaults to the airport on the current page.

terminal.description: Terminal name or number, if known.

precheck.description: True for TSA PreCheck or another expedited lane.
